title: Organizations
summary: Organizations bring together people, repositories and the LLM policy the whole team follows.
usage: Create an organization, invite members and link repositories on the site. In the app, each organization is an environment: choose it under the logo, and the side menu shows its projects, statistics, gatehouse, members, repositories, MCP and skills. Invitations arrive in the bell, where you accept or decline them. In Members, owners and maintainers also see pending invitations.
